subject: Exclusive Summer Sale Event Inside!
body: Dear valued customer, Get ready to enjoy our exclusive summer sale event this weekend! Take advantage of up to 50% off on select items and enjoy special discounts on new arrivals. Hurry, this offer is only available for a limited time. Visit our store or shop online to discover amazing deals on your favorite products. Don't miss out on this opportunity to refresh your wardrobe for the season! We look forward to seeing you there.
